parsed.notes: The Credit Agreement with Fifth Third Bank has two financial covenants, a Leverage Ratio and a Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, but the excerpt gives no actual values or required levels for either. The leverage ratio is also used to set the interest margin (2.00%-3.00%) and the unused fee (0.20%-0.30%); those are pricing terms, not covenant limits. There were no borrowings outstanding at September 30, 2026 or December 31, 2025.
